title: Charities newsletter 3 — September 2026
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC to keep you updated on developments likely to be of interest, and to serve as a reminder to continuously maintain and monitor your eligibility to remain registered as a charity.

 This newsletter has articles on:

 • signing up and taking part in user research sessions

 • a new HMRC video highlighting how Gift Aid works

 • guidance reviews

 • updates to charity services and systems
